rubric_T5.question: Given only the brief and the excerpts on the row, is this answer desk-ready? No outside knowledge; model hidden.

anchors.5: Correct, grounded in the excerpts, usable as-is
anchors.4: Correct and grounded; trivial edit (wording, format)
anchors.3: Right substance; real edit needed (missing cite or detail, loose wording)
anchors.2: Partly wrong or ungrounded; you would rewrite most of it
anchors.1: Wrong, invents facts, or confidently contradicts the excerpt

rubric_T5.escalate: Score whether handing up was the right call; a justified ESCALATE on G1 passes regardless of score (§5).
